recipes.name: Lemon-Cream Cheese Cupcakes
ingredients_raw: 1 (18.25 ounce) package (2-layer size) white cake mix
1 (3.4 ounce) package Jell-O Lemon Instant Pudding
1 (250 g) package Philadelphia Brick Cream Cheese, softened

steps.text: Beat first 5 ingredients in large bowl with mixer on low speed 1 min. or until dry ingredients are moistened. (Batter will be thick.) Beat on medium speed 2 min. Spoon into 24 paper-lined muffin cups.
Bake 21 to 24 min. or until toothpick inserted in centres comes out clean. Cool in pans 10 min.; remove to wire racks. Cool completely.
Beat cream cheese, butter and lemon juice in large bowl with mixer until well blended. Gradually add sugar, beating well after each addition. Spread onto cupcakes.

raw_recipe.headline: Lemon-Cream Cheese Cupcakes
raw_recipe.description: These moist cupcakes made with lemon pudding are topped with lemony cream-cheese frosting.

review.reviewBody: This recipe is great! The only modification I made was using a lemon cake mix because my husband likes his lemon cake lemony!! In my oven 20 minutes was perfect. The cupcakes were very light and moist and the icing was just right too!

Amazing lemon flavor with a few adjustments. I substituted the white cake for lemon cake mix and I added 1 tablespoon lemon juice. I also used room temperature egg whites. These cupcakes baked perfectly after 20 minutes. For the frosting, I followed the directions but added a splash of vanilla. I severed these cupcakes chilled and my family absolutely LOVED them.
I made this recipe with lemon cake mix. Instead of water, I added no pulp orange juice to add to the citrus flavor. I also added lemon zest to the cream cheese frosting.

These cupcakes were wonderful. However it made more than a dozen, but that was actually a good thing! I added some lemon zest to the batter and used can cream cheese frosting that I flavored with some lemon zest and lemon juice, thicken it with a little powdered sugar. My family loved it!

I made these and they came out perfect. If you let the eggs come to room temperature, it will make a huge difference to the recipe. I did a lemon filling and it was even better with a layer of rasberry seedless jam and it was the best.

These cupcakes are amazing. As I make my cupcakes a little larger, my yield is only 18. As mentioned in other reviews, I also use a lemon cake mix and also add lemon zest to both the batter and icing. I get rave reviews when I make these.
I used a lemon cake mix and vanilla pudding because that's what I had. It was delicious and everyone complimented me on them.

My mom bought the ingredients. She couldn't find lemon pudding, so we swapped and did vanilla pudding with lemon cake. Yield was 24 regular cupcakes. Perfect frosting with fresh squeezed lemon. Cook time 23 minutes. Prep was easy. Frosting held up so well. Awesome.

These cupcakes were a little time consuming, but delicious. I would suggest baking them for only 21 or 22 minutes, not the full twenty-five. I put a knife in the middle to check it, but the cupcakes seemed like they needed to bake longer when they were in fact done. I think this has to do with the pudding being added, but I am not sure. This was the first time I made a cake with pudding mix. Other than that they were wonderful. I think next time I will add the lemon zest to the cake mix for a little extra lemon flavor.
I used a lemon cake mix, and I added a little extra salted butter and some lemon zest to the frosting. I will make it again. Using all egg whites makes these very light and fluffy.

Good flavor exactly as written. Not fantastic, but really good. Only "change" I made was to add a little zest to the frosting and a little more to decorate on top. Made mini-cupcakes. (Recipe made 36 minis; baked for 12-13 minutes in case anyone is interested.)
I made this recipe exactly as written except I used a lemon cake mix. These were very dense and dry and the frosting did not hold its shape after being piped. Disappointed.

Icing was fantastic. The cake I made one change to. Instead of water, I used my Meyer lemon juice. When I tasted the batter, it was tart, and is little worried, but the icing made them perfect. A huge hit for two different groups of friends
I used lemon cake mix & added fresh blueberries & it was delicious! Will definitely make again.

Easy to make and very tasty with a little something extra. Made it for a group picnic take and went over very well. I used a lemon cake mix and sprinkled some extra lemon zest to the top along with a candied lemon gummy wedge.
Delicious, definitely will make again!
Made the exact recipe. They are delicious, moist, icing creamy and lightly lemony...
Delicious .. the only change I made was to add a couple tablespoons lemon meringue yogurt .. I loved them and made them for a party and not one was left

I used lemon cake mix instead of white and made 18 rather than 24 cupcakes. I ended up with twice as much frosting as I needed, that part of the recipe could be halved. Everyone who tried them loved them!

Very yummy! I made changes because I've never been good at following directions (subbed buttermilk for half the liquid and added a squeeze of lemon juice). I also made a batch with lemon cake mix and a lemon buttercream frosting for my non-cream cheese loving friends (as crazy as that is). Both received great reviews. Not quite as good as the cakes from scratch, but pretty close and much easier!
